sports.name: Sierra Club Griffith Park Tuesday Evening Hikes
sports.why: Get an evening outdoor workout and meet fellow hikers across a range of abilities.
sports.summary: Tuesday evening conditioning hikes in Griffith Park start at 7:00 PM from the Merry Go Round Lot Two; simultaneous leader-led routes cover levels 1–6, last about two hours, and typically draw 30–60 people. Newcomers should arrive early to sign a waiver (pink waiver card issued if needed) and bring water and appropriate footwear.

sports.name: Sierra Club Griffith Park Thursday Evening Hikes
sports.why: For a free, leveled evening trail workout led by experienced leaders.
sports.summary: Guided evening hikes in Griffith Park starting at 7pm with simultaneous groups across difficulty levels (1–6); hikes last about two hours and are led by trained leaders. Newcomers should arrive early to sign the required waiver and obtain a pink waiver card valid through the end of 2026.

sports.name: FRIDAY--Easy Night walk around Silverlake
sports.address: 1850 W Silver Lake Dr, Los Angeles, CA
sports.why: To enjoy a short, social outdoor stroll with dog-friendly company and optional post-walk drinks.
sports.summary: An easy 2.2-mile round-trip evening walk around Silver Lake starting from the Silver Lake Recreation Center at 7:15pm; the route takes about an hour with a short uphill section. Dogs are allowed on leash, rain will cancel, street parking is available (more along W. Silverlake Dr.), and some members sometimes go to the local oyster bar afterward.

sports.name: Explore Griffith Park
sports.venue: Griffith Park Merry Go Round Lot 2
sports.address: Merry Go Round Lot Two, LOS ANGELES, CA
sports.why: For a brisk, scenic workout with sweeping park views.
sports.summary: Moderately strenuous group hike in Griffith Park starting at the Merry Go Round Lot 2, typically about 2 hours and roughly 4 miles with steep ascents and descents on single-track trails. The hike moves at a fairly rapid pace and usually starts at 3:30 p.m.

sports.name: Griffith Park 9 Peaks (Moderate Pace)
sports.venue: Griffith Park Merry Go Round Parking Lot #2
sports.address: 4668 Crystal Springs Drive, Los Angeles, CA, Los Angeles, CA
sports.why: For experienced hikers looking for a long, steep, technical workout with big elevation gain.
sports.summary: An advanced 11.5-mile Griffith Park hike starting at Griffith Park Merry Go Round Parking Lot #2, with about 3,000' elevation gain and an estimated 7-hour duration (meeting 07:00). Trails are single-file, rocky and largely unshaded; bring at least 3 liters of water, and note dogs and guests are not allowed.

sports.summary: A Santa-themed run taking place in Griffith Park on December 6, 2026.
